T: Ho ho no. Pass the sandwiches.
D: A drunken safecracker works as a mall Santa every Christmas so he can rob the place.
P: Serve the sandwiches when the kid makes Willie his lunch.
S: Thurman's toasted peanut butter and jam
the lonely kid who makes Willie sandwiches

Thick white bread with crunchy peanut butter and strawberry jam, dipped in cinnamon egg and fried golden in butter, cut into triangles. Spread 4 slices of thick white bread with crunchy peanut butter and 4 with strawberry jam and press together. Whisk 2 eggs with 100ml milk and a pinch of cinnamon. Dip each sandwich briefly on both sides and fry in butter over medium heat for 3 minutes a side until golden. Cut into triangles and dust with icing sugar.
the advent calendar the kid keeps
Little dark and milk chocolate squares in a numbered tray, each with a toasted hazelnut or a pinch of sea salt.
the Phoenix mall where Willie and Marcus work the season

Frankfurts wrapped in soft pretzel dough, dipped in bicarb water and baked dark with rock salt, with a hot mustard and beer cheese dip. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Roll into 8 ropes and coil around 8 frankfurts. Dip in simmering water with 60g bicarb for 20 seconds, sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 15 minutes. Melt 150g grated cheddar into a sauce of 20g butter, 1 tbsp flour and 200ml beer, plus 1 tsp hot mustard.
M: Christmas in Phoenix, tamales on every table

Masa beaten fluffy with lard and stock, wrapped around red chilli pork in corn husks, steamed tender, with salsa verde and crema. Simmer 800g pork shoulder until tender, about 2 hours, then shred. Blend 4 soaked dried guajillo chillies with garlic, cumin and 250ml stock, fry for 5 minutes and stir through the pork. Beat 150g lard until fluffy, then beat in 500g masa harina, 2 tsp baking powder, salt and 500ml warm stock. Spread on 16 soaked corn husks, fill, fold and steam upright for 75 minutes. Serve with salsa verde and sour cream.
a sad Christmas at the diner
Roast turkey breast, stuffing, mashed potato, gravy and cranberry sauce, a proper diner Christmas plate done right.
W: Rich fruit cake with brandy-soaked fruit, almonds and spice, baked low and slow at 150C for 2.5 hours, sliced thin.
K: the flask Santa keeps under the suit

Bourbon over plenty of ice topped with spicy ginger beer and fresh lime, a cinnamon stick for Christmas. Ginger beer and lime for anyone driving the sleigh. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 45ml bourbon and 15ml lime juice to each, then top with 150ml cold spicy ginger beer. Stir once and add a lime wedge and a cinnamon stick. Skip the bourbon for the non-drinkers.

s.how: Melt 150g dark chocolate and 150g milk chocolate separately. Spoon into small squares on baking paper or an ice cube tray. Top half with a toasted hazelnut and half with a pinch of sea salt. Set in the fridge, then line them up in a numbered tray.

m.note: a sad Christmas at the diner
m.how: Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast for a few hours, then roast at 170C until it reaches 70C inside. Bake stuffing mix in a dish alongside. Mash 1kg potatoes with butter and make gravy from the pan juices and stock. Serve with cranberry sauce on proper plates.

w.how: Soak 1kg mixed dried fruit in 125ml brandy overnight. Cream 250g butter with 250g brown sugar, beat in 4 eggs, then fold in the fruit, 300g flour, spice and a handful of almonds. Bake in a lined tin at 150C for 2.5 hours. Cool and slice thin.
